author: IGN
description:
In this 007 First Light guide, we're showing where to find all 92 Collectibles, plus including the checkpoint and a timestamp for every single one of them. We have everything broken out by chapter and list how many Collectibles should be found in each one. You cannot miss any Collectibles, but once they're picked up, they do not show up again in these missions no matter when you found them or what save file you were using at the time -- they will all be in your Collectibles menu.

Chapter 01: Against the Odds
00:00 - 7 of Acorns (Cards)
00:35 - Cruciform Key (Legacy)
01:24 - Iceland Postcard (Postcards)
02:11 - Satellite Part (Mementos)

Chapter 03: The Needle's Eye
02:44 - Malta Postcard (Postcards)

Chapter 04: The Heart of the Matter
03:28 - Workshop Notice/Selina Tan (Intel)
03:48 - Recruit Stats/00 Recruits (Intel)

Chapter 05: A New Home
05:37 - Dress Box/Cressida Bright (Intel)
06:04 - Family Photo/Lennox Monroe (Intel)
06:26 - Under of Acorns (Cards)
07:13 - 7 of Roses (Cards)
title: 007 First Light - All 92 Collectibles Locations

description:
Take a look at the 'In Studio: Ludwig Göransson' Featurette for The Odyssey, the latest mythological action retelling of Homer's tale from the mind of Christopher Nolan. Hear from the composer of the film, Ludwig Göransson, and Christopher Nolan on the creation of the soundtrack for the upcoming film. The Odyssey is in theaters on July 17.

Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX® film technology. The film brings Homer’s foundational saga to IMAX® film screens for the first time and opens in theaters everywhere on July 17, 2026. 

The Odyssey stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson and Lupita Nyong’o, with Zendaya and Charlize Theron.

The Odyssey is produced by Emma Thomas and Christopher Nolan for their company, Syncopy. The executive producer is Thomas Hayslip.
title: The Odyssey - Official 'In Studio: Ludwig Göransson' Featurette (2026) Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Creepshow announcement trailer for this video game adaptation horror anthology series. Creepshow will be available in August 2026 for PC via Steam. 

Inspired by the hit television series executive produced by horror legend Greg Nicotero, the game brings the franchise’s signature blend of wicked scares, twisted humor, and comic-book style dread into a new medium. Developed by PHL with creative direction from Brian Clarke (The Mortuary Assistant), Creepshow embraces the spirit of the beloved anthology franchise through self-contained tales of terror, delivering dramatic gameplay and shocking surprises.

From psychological horror to the blackest of humor, players will step into stories where death is often the least of their worries. Follow Danny and his friends as the search for the truth of what happened to Danny’s father quickly turns dark as they uncover sinister secrets. Fate brings Danny to The Reader, a mysterious fortune-teller, who has a taste for treacherous tale
title: Creepshow - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Emily Blunt Featurette for Disclosure Day, an upcoming sci-fi film created and directed by Steven Spielberg. Disclosure Day stars Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer, A Quiet Place), Josh O’Connor (Challengers, The Crown), Colin Firth (The King’s Speech, Kingsman franchise), Eve Hewson (Bad Sisters, The Perfect Couple), and Colman Domingo (Sing Sing, Rustin). Witness the world come to terms with humans not being alone in the universe in Disclosure Day, in theaters on June 12.

If you found out we weren’t alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to seven billion people. We are coming close to … Disclosure Day. 

Based on a story by Spielberg, the screenplay is by David Koepp. Disclosure Day is produced by Kristie Macosko Krieger (The Fabelmans, West Side Story) and by Spielberg for Amblin Entertainment. The executive producers are Adam Somner and Chris Brigham. 

Disclosure Day opens in theaters June 12.
title: Disclosure Day - Official Emily Blunt Featurette (2026) Josh O'Connor, Colin Firth

author: IGN
description:
Watch the Ninja Scroll trailer as Iconic Events Releasing and AMC Global Media’s HIDIVE present the new 4K restoration of the samurai film in North American theaters in October 2026. The limited theatrical release of Ninja Scroll 4K will screen on October 4, 5 & 7 across the U.S. and Canada.

When Jubei saves a young ninja woman from the unthinkable, he assumes that’s the end of it. To his surprise, it’s only just the beginning. Together, the two investigate the mysterious deaths of an entire village which uncovers a conspiracy of demonic proportions! Getting closer to the truth, the demonic forces will stop at nothing to silence Jubei and his companion for good! 

Written and directed by Yoshiaki Kawajiri, Ninja Scroll was originally released in 1993 and is now considered a truly seminal work in anime filmmaking. The 4K restoration of Ninja Scroll was produced by AMC Global Media’s Sentai under the supervision of Director Yoshiaki Kawajiri and was screened for this first time earlier
title: Ninja Scroll - Official Theatrical Release 4K Restoration Trailer (English Subtitles)

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the 'Minions Take a Limo Ride' Clip for Minions & Monsters, the upcoming installment in the animated film series distributed by Universal Pictures. The voice cast includes Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, with Trey Parker and Pierre Coffin. Minions & Monsters opens in theaters on July 1, 2026.

Minions & Monsters is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

Minions & Monsters is directed by Pierre Coffin, a director of the first three Despicable Me films and the first Minions film. Coffin has also provided the voice for the Minions since their film debut in 2010. The film is written by Brian Lynch (Minions, The Secret Life of Pets films) and Pierre Coffin and is produced by Illumination’s
title: Minions & Monsters - Official 'Minions Take a Limo Ride' Clip

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Official Trailer for Heart of the Beast, an action drama film distributed by Paramount Pictures. Experience survival through the eyes of a man and his best friend in Heart of the Beast, in theaters on September 25.

After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

Heart of the Beast stars Brad Pitt, J.K. Simmons, and Anna Lambe. The film is directed by David Ayer and written by Cameron Alexander.

Heart of the Beast is in theaters on September 25.
title: Heart of the Beast - Official Trailer (2026) Brad Pitt, J.K. Simmons, Anna Lambe

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Season 3 Trailer for The Walking Dead: Dead City, the hit zombie action spin-off series in The Walking Dead universe distributed by AMC. Legacy characters fight for a thriving community in Manhattan in Season 3 of The Walking Dead: Dead City, streaming on AMC and AMC+ on July 26.

Maggie and Negan finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse, but when chaos in the city begins to arise, they are forced to question: have they learned from their old wounds or will their dark past spell doom for the entire city?  

Season 3 of The Walking Dead: Dead City stars Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Lauren Cohan, Jimmi Simpson, Raúl Castillo, Aimee Garcia, Logan Kim, Michael Emery, and more. The series is executive produced by Scott M. Gimple and showran by Seth Hoffman, Cohan, Morgan, Brian Bockrath, and Colin Walsh.

Season 3 of The Walking Dead: Dead City is streaming on AMC and AMC+ on July 26.
title: The Walking Dead: Dead City - Official Season 3 Trailer (2026) Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Lauren Cohan

author: IGN
description:
At its core, the design of Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, the remake or "reimagining" of the 1996 original, attempts to blend the classic feel of Lara Croft’s movement with a more modern approach to combat and exploration.

You know what Tomb Raider is. Chances are you’ve played on one of Lara Croft’s many adventures, or at least one of the cinematic action-adventures that her original 1996 expedition inspired, whether that be the Uncharted, Horizon, or Star Wars Jedi series. But now it’s time to go all the way back, as Legacy of Atlantis takes us full circle in a reimagining of the story that kick-started a genre.

#IGN #TombRaiderLegacyOfAtlantis #Preview
title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - The First Preview

author: IGN
description:
As STALKER 2's first expansion, Cost of Hope explores the long-running conflict within the Zone between two iconic factions. Zulu, a series veteran from Duty, and Mavka, a member of Freedom, are set to uncover new and terrifying mysteries of the Zone under increasingly tense circumstances. Caught in a rapidly unfolding chapter of an age-old confrontation, Skif — the protagonist controlled by the player — must follow previously unexplored paths and face dangers beyond comprehension, choosing sides and once again shaping the future of Chornobyl through his decisions.

Cost of Hope is due out this Summer for PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PS5.

#IGN #Gaming
title: STALKER 2: Cost of Hope – Official Story and Characters Trailer
